<thought>I need to determine how many aromatic carbon atoms are in the unknown molecule. The only way to get structural information is to request its 13C NMR spectrum, which will show signals in the aromatic region (≈120‑150 ppm). By counting those signals I can infer the number of distinct aromatic carbons, which for a typical aromatic ring equals the number of aromatic carbons present (assuming symmetry may reduce distinct signals, but the question likely expects the total count of aromatic carbons, not distinct signals). I'll request the carbon NMR spectrum.</thought>
<action>carbon_nmr_spectra</action>
